summary: The discussion explores two proposals to resolve ALPN version explosion issues in QUIC/MQX implementations: upgrading Web Transport to negotiate MQX versions alongside H3 ALPN, or consolidating MQX and MQX versions into a single TLS ALPN field. Participants debated the trade-offs between these approaches, noting that while early private deployments face challenges due to rigid standards, a unified MQX ALPN strategy offers simplicity and avoids version proliferation. The group agreed to consolidate related specifications into a concise draft recommending MQX over MQX, with further technical details to be addressed in upcoming sessions.
